dimensions.notes: Façade ≈6.4 m wide × ≈12.8 m to the eaves, scaled from the elevation. Gross area ≈ 80 m² before openings.

current.summary: Rendered façade on a sloping street. Ground floor: arched front door with radiating stone voussoirs, rusticated stone jambs and an ornamental iron fanlight; barred window to the left; stone-clad plinth. First floor: French window with Juliet balcony. Second floor: French window with projecting wrought-iron balcony, above a moulded string course. Third floor: terrace with railings between piers. Pitched roof in coppi tiles with a rainwater downpipe on the left.
